text:
incident-bot: PAGER — Sev 1: Errors/503s observed for tenant 'HavenHealth' on Dedicated VPC (pool: dhp-2). Symptoms started ~10:15 UTC. High error rate on requests pinned to artifact v1.2.3 (canary). Alert: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/98765

emily: +1 seeing spikes in 503s and queued requests on dhp-2-canary nodes. Repro rate ~40% for endpoints that hit the pinned model.

aj: I'm on-call. paging in. Can you paste the root cause hypothesis?

emily: Logs show OOM/eviction patterns and repeated model load retries for v1.2.3 on the dedicated GPUs; memory footprint jumped ~18% vs v1.2.2. Looks like a regression in the artifact that surfaces only under pinned canary traffic.

maria: Customer impacted — HavenHealth production traffic from a single region. They reported timeouts from their service desk at 10:23 UTC. We have an open SEAT. They need an ETA/mitigation ASAP.

aj: OK. Primary mitigations: (1) revert tenant to previous pinned artifact (v1.2.2) (2) fail over routing to a compatible hosted variant as fallback if revert takes >10m (3) scale temporary burst if needed. Who can perform the revert?

sanjay: I can handle the revert. The revert path for dedicated/VPC pinned artifacts: update tenant pin in tenant-config and trigger a canary rollout for that tenant. CLI:

```
# revert pinned artifact for tenant
redwoodctl tenant patch --tenant-id=havenhealth --set pinned_artifact=redwood/model:v1.2.2
redwoodctl rollout trigger --tenant-id=havenhealth --strategy=canary --timeout=300
```

Need to ensure pinned artifact exists on dhp-2 nodes (it should). Also will drain canary pods for v1.2.3 gradually.

emily: note: metric to watch: token_latency_p50, model_load_errors, gpu_mem_free. Streaming logs show model_load_time spikes right before 503s.

aj: Maria, please tell the customer we're reverting to v1.2.2 and expect ~5–7m to restore. Ask them to hold noncritical traffic. I'll trigger fallback to hosted if revert does not reduce errors.

maria: On it. Messaging HavenHealth support: "We are reverting your tenant to a known-good pinned artifact v1.2.2. Anticipated recovery within 10 minutes. We will update as soon as traffic stabilizes."

ops-bot: @oncall-rota — starting tenant config change preview: diff shows pinned_artifact: v1.2.3 -> v1.2.2. Applies to dedicated pool dhp-2.

sanjay: executing revert now. Posting command output:

```
redwoodctl tenant patch --tenant-id=havenhealth --set pinned_artifact=redwood/model:v1.2.2
> 200 OK - tenant updated
redwoodctl rollout trigger --tenant-id=havenhealth --strategy=canary --timeout=300
> rollout started (canary 10% -> 100%)
```

aj: Good. Start monitoring. I'll open a temporary routing policy fallback in case the canary stalls:

```
# temporary routing override
redwoodctl routing update --tenant-id=havenhealth --policy fallback-hosted --duration 15m
```

This routes new requests to hosted-compatible model variant (latency slightly higher, but stays up).

emily: Canopy metrics: model_load_errors down from 220 -> 18 in last 2m after revert triggered. 503 rate dropping from 38% -> 6% on canary nodes.

maria: HavenHealth confirms partial recovery: "errors dropped for us, thanks — still seeing occasional timeouts on long requests."

aj: Keep fallback policy ready but not applied unless errors >10% sustained for 3m. Sanjay, are there any residual issues like cache invalidation or KV mismatches after revert?

sanjay: There may be stale KV entries for tokenization cache if the new artifact changed tokenizer behavior, but in our tests v1.2.2 is compatible. Will run cache flush on canary pods as a precaution:

```
# flush KV cache on tenant pods
redwoodctl tenant exec --tenant-id=havenhealth --cmd "python -c 'from redwood.cache import flush_tenant; flush_tenant("havenhealth")'"
```

Done.

emily: Metrics now: 503s at 1.2%, model_load_errors ~2. CPU/GPU mem back to baseline. Latency p95 still elevated ~100ms above baseline for a minute but trending down.

aj: Great. Maria, tell customer we're seeing recovery and will keep monitoring for 30m. Ask them to run verification tests for their critical paths.

maria: Messaged customer: "Recovery in progress. Please validate critical flows and escalate if you see anything else. We'll run a postmortem and share timeline."

ops-bot: Routing override is still staged. Not applied.

aj: Handing off to next oncall for 30m monitoring window. @sanjay — can you own post-revert validation and logs? @emily — keep an eye on infra metrics. Oncall-> @alex will take the 30m watch.

sanjay: I will own validation. Steps: verify model_load_errors stay <5, 503s <1%, and run synthetic checkout flow from the same region; I will also collect heapdumps from a failing pod just in case.

emily: Collected one heapdump and a model_graft log snippet. Pushed to /artifacts/incidents/1765009876/ for postmortem.

alex (oncall-rota): taking watch. Thanks team.

maria: Customer thanks the team and asked for an RCA. We'll coordinate postmortem and timeline.

aj: Quick action items: (1) Sanjay collect detailed artifact difference (v1.2.2 vs v1.2.3) and root cause (2) Runtime team evaluate memory regression and add unit/regression test (3) Product notify model owners to freeze canary until regression fixed (4) CS follow up with HavenHealth with timeline and mitigations.

sanjay: Logged follow-up ticket: INF-4521 — investigate memory increase in artifact v1.2.3, attach heapdumps and diffs.

emily: Closing pager — services stable and no customer-facing errors for 10m.

incident-bot: Incident resolved for thread 1765009876 — severity downgraded to P1 (monitoring). Please file postmortem in /postmortems with tag: tenant-dedicated-revert.

maria: I'll schedule a short postmortem and include customer notes. Great runbook execution, team. :thumbsup:

customer-ops: Thanks everyone for the fast revert, appreciate the transparency.

aj: Leaving final note — don't merge v1.2.3 to stable until INF-4521 validated. Handing over to infra and runtime. If anyone needs artifacts or logs, they're under the incident folder.

alex (oncall-rota): Confirmed stable for 30m window, closing watch at 11:05 UTC.

emily: marking thread for postmortem and adding links to artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/1765009876/heapdumps, https://logs.redwood/internal/1765009876/model_graft.log

--- end of thread ---
